title: Correct the Wrong Word
instruction: Each sentence has one wrong word. Choose the correct word.

questions.sentence: Are you still ______ contact with any friends from university?
I’m going to split up with Dan because we’ve got nothing ______ common.
I don’t think I’d like to live ______ myself.
Would you like to live ______ your own?
Fiona didn’t break your MP3 player ______ purpose. It was an accident!
Guess what! Mike and Julie are ______ love with each other.
